description:
From the fz-kdt.119 cold review (2026-09-01):
native_codegen/prim.rs:~1176, lower_runtime_type_predicate's fast
path under destination-passing (fz-qwf TupleFields) answers the WHOLE
type test with iconst(tuple_arities.contains(delivered_arity)) --
derived from how many field params exist, never touching a value.
Sound only while the predicate is arity-only; the instant it is
payload-aware (fz-kdt.119) this is wrong and silent on exactly the
lanes destination-passing optimized. Delete, or re-emit against the
field params -- which are precisely the values the per-field test
needs, so the repair is an opportunity (test the fields directly, no
re-boxing). fz-kdt.119's spec item 5 lands this in-story; this ticket
tracks it independently in case 119 is staged.
title: P1: delivered_tuple_field_arity answers a runtime type test with a compile-time constant
